store.tagline: Your private Telegram remote for Möbius chats, with secure owner pairing.
store.description:
Chat with Möbius from a dedicated Telegram bot, paired to your private account. Keep Bridge-owned conversations separate, choose a model, start a fresh chat and explicitly continue a saved conversation. Exact ordinary questions can be answered in Telegram; sensitive and unsupported cards open in Möbius. Chats, Bots and Tools provide a compact management interface in Möbius. Optional Studio shortcuts show only separately authorized configuration metadata.

Set up the bot key through a sealed form in your owner chat. The listener uses the key only for fixed Telegram methods. Other accounts and groups cannot use your personal Bridge. Work is ordered, and uncertain submissions or deliveries are not automatically rerun. Model usage follows your configured provider.

This edition works with supported public Möbius contracts without a platform patch. It does not include the Telegram Mini App, transcript previews, archive/delete controls, screenshots or media delivery, topics, direct Studio customization-chat grants or Telegram user-management controls. Private files and unsupported actions open in Möbius after sign-in. Review COMPATIBILITY.md before upgrading a different edition. Screenshots use fictional data.
